card.name: Punctuation and links before PD-L1 or drug names
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (the, on, of, positive, a semicolon or open parenthesis) just before a biomarker or a second drug name. Seen in oncology and HIV prescribing text such as KEYTRUDA, CABENUVA and TIVICAY.

modes.label: Patient selection wording
modes.description: Words like on, the, of, positive leading into PD-L1 expression in patient-selection sentences.

modes.description: A semicolon or open parenthesis after a drug name, before a partner drug or score.
